name: Deezer
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: Music metadata from Deezer: artist pictures, album covers up to 1900x1900, genres, labels, release dates, track lists, and ISRC and UPC codes. No API key or account required. A third source beside MusicBrainz and Last.fm, strongest for singles, remixes and recent releases.
fixMatchHint: Enter a Deezer id with its kind (artist:27, album:302127, track:3135556), a deezer.com artist, album or track URL, isrc: followed by a track's ISRC, or upc: followed by an album's UPC.

background_tasks.description: Looks up Deezer metadata for artists, albums and tracks that have not been enriched by Deezer yet.
Re-fetches all Deezer metadata to pick up new covers and corrected genres. Slow on a large library.
